resources.string: Marks, timetable, absences, and smarter school insights in one place.

Create your private Gradey ID with Google to sync settings across Android devices and enable notifications. You can also continue without it and connect school now.
Sign in with the same Google account you used to create Gradey ID. There is no separate password.

Thank you for using Gradey. Building and running it has real costs; cloud and API services alone have already cost more than $700. Supporting us is optional — with a one-time tip, or with recurring support that raises the Gradey AI daily limit and unlocks early access. You can keep using Gradey either way.
